title: Avantor / VWR International
content:
Avantor / VWR International is listed on Aerogela as a aerogel supplier with public positioning in aerogel materials, insulation-related products, or adjacent advanced-materials applications. This profile is designed to help buyers, researchers, and sourcing teams quickly understand the company's market relevance and supplier fit.

Avantor, through its VWR distribution channel, is one of the largest scientific materials distributors in Europe. The company resells advanced materials, including aerogel-related products, to laboratories, industrial R&D teams, and technical buyers.

  • Coverage Area: Europe-wide
  • Focus Areas: Scientific distribution, specialty chemicals, materials-science procurement, and aerogel-related catalog supply
  • Current Brands Represented: Avantor, VWR, and selected third-party specialty-material lines
  • Official Website: https://www.avantorsciences.com/
